dedupe_keys.name: oliana anticline petrophysical and thermal rock properties

description: This deposit contains laboratory measurements of rocks from the Oliana anticline in the Southern Pyrenees, Spain, investigated as an analogue for geothermal reservoirs. The research team characterizes mineral and bulk density, connected porosity, permeability, P-wave velocity, thermal conductivity and thermal effusivity. Samples from detrital, carbonate and evaporite units are oriented parallel and perpendicular to bedding before testing. Mendeley provides three Excel workbooks free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is an outcrop-sampling campaign; the short repository metadata do not provide a common observation calendar or a subsurface monitoring series. Laboratory specimens and outcrop alteration limit transfer to temperatures, stresses and fluid conditions in an operating geothermal reservoir. A reviewer-assessed use is setting uncertainty ranges for coupled heat and fluid-flow simulations. model-arehs-opengeosys-deep-geological-repository-workflow provides a related subsurface modelling example for a different application. No specimens, workbook calculations or reservoir model were independently assessed.
